page.title: Account
page.description: Manage your profile, security and active sessions.
page.languageDescription: The language the dashboard is shown in for you.

loginHistory.title: Login history
loginHistory.description: Recent sign-in attempts on your account.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Update the password used to sign in to your account.
changePassword.toastUpdated: Password updated. Your other sessions have been signed out.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.
sessions.toastAllTerminated: Signed out of all other sessions
sessions.terminateAllDescription: This immediately signs you out everywhere except this device.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Require a verification code from an authenticator app when signing in.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: This invalidates your existing recovery codes. Confirm your password to continue.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Your account will only be protected by your password. Confirm your password to continue.
twoFactor.enrollInstructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy...), then enter the 6-digit code it generates.
twoFactor.manualEntryPrefix: Can't scan it? Enter this code manually:
twoFactor.recoveryCodesDescription: Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.

actions.invalidCode: Invalid code. Check your authenticator app and try again.

actions.passwordReused: You've used that password before. Choose a different one.
actions.passwordChangedNotificationMessage: Your password was changed. If this wasn't you, contact your administrator immediately.
